XenotypeDef.label: rosharan lighteyes
XenotypeDef.description: The lighteyed caste rules across the Vorin nations of Roshar. Born to command, educated in warfare and politics, they hold their station by tradition, blade, and blood. Alethi, Veden, Herdazian - the color of the eyes binds them all in shared rank.

XenotypeDef.label: rosharan darkeyes
XenotypeDef.description: The dark-eyed masses form the foundation of Vorin society. Soldiers, merchants, farmers, craftsmen - their hands build what the lighteyes command. Tough, resilient, and far more numerous than those who rule them.
